parameters.title: W7 第二轮后范围校准
parameters.initialPrompt: 你是只读SENIOR_REVIEWER，purpose=scope_audit。读.ai/roles/senior-reviewer.md及.ai/task/repair-w7-20260922/SCOPE-AUDIT-R2.json和其精确冻结引用。仅校准输入两项finding的范围、可观察影响、比例性及最小充分动作，不承担译文审核、不提出新finding、不写文件、不创建agent。不要读其他任务、未引用当前译文或其他意见。返回纯JSON数组，按输入顺序恰两项，每项恰含finding_ref,assessment,design_ac_basis,observable_impact,personal_project_proportionality,minimum_sufficient_action,rationale七个非空字符串；finding_ref用.ai/reviews/repair-w7-20260922/host-findings-r2.json / <id>；assessment仅keep|narrow|downgrade|reject|defer_to_user。不要Markdown包裹。

availableModes.label: Default Permissions

availableModes.label: Auto-review

response.guidance: You will get notified when the created agent finishes, errors, or needs permission. Do not poll for status; continue with other work until the notification arrives.
